title: Ardent Health Announces Proposed Secondary Offering of Common Stock and Concurrent Share Repurchase
summary: Ardent Health Announces Proposed Secondary Offering of Common Stock and Concurrent Share Repurchase wroberts Tue, 11/17/2026 - 15:57 BRENTWOOD, Tenn. (November 17, 2026) – Ardent Health, Inc. (NYSE: ARDT) (“Ardent Health” or the “Company”) today announced the commencement of a proposed secondary public offering (the “Offering”) of 8,000,000 shares of its common stock, consisting of 7,136,719 shares of its common stock by an affiliate of Equity Group Investments and 863,281 shares of its common stock by an affiliate of Ventas, Inc. (together, the “Selling Stockholders”). In connection with the Offering, the Selling Stockholders intend to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,200,000 shares of common stock at the public offering price, less the underwriting discounts and commissions. Subject to the completion of the Offering, the Company intends to concurrently repurchase from the underwriters up to 1,500,000 of the shares of its common stock that are the subject of the Offering, at a price per share equal to the price per share to be paid by the underwriters to the Selling Stockholders (the “Concurrent Share Repurchase”). The Company intends to fund the Concurrent Share Repurchase from its existing cash on hand. The Concurrent Share Repurchase is not being made pursuant to the Company’s previously disclosed stock repurchase plan and will not reduce available repurchase capacity thereunder. The underwriters will not receive any compensation for the shares being repurchased by the Company. The Offering is not conditioned upon the completion of the Concurrent Share Repurchase. The Selling Stockholders are offering all of the shares of common stock being sold in the Offering, including any shares that may be sold in connection with the exercise of the underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares. The Company is not selling any shares of its common stock in the Offering and will not receive any proceeds from the sale of the shares by the Selling Stockholders. J.P. Morgan and Barclays are acting as lead book-running managers for the Offering. BofA Securities, Citigroup, Leerink Partners, Mizuho, RBC Capital Markets, Stephens Inc. and Truist Securities are also acting as bookrunners for the Offering. Capital One Securities is acting as co-manager for the Offering. The proposed Offering will be made only by means of a prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus. Copies of the preliminary prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus relating to the Offering may be obtained by contacting J.P. You may also obtain these documents for free by visiting EDGAR on the website of the Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) at www.sec.gov . A registration statement on Form S-3 relating to the Offering was declared effective by the SEC on August 25, 2025. A preliminary prospectus supplement relating to the Offering has also been filed with the SEC.
